source: 742 Rewards
target: 742 Praemia

source: 742 Rewards
target: 742 Praemia

source: That dark coin pouch was indeed a Traveler’s Bag, containing three items: One was a sheepskin parchment of a brownish hue, another was a nearly invisible triangular spike, and the last was a mechanically intricate black revolver.
target: Illud obscurum marsupium monetarium revera erat Sacculus Viatoris, tribus rebus instructum: una erat charta membrata ex pelle ovinā fusca; altera erat spiculum triangulare fere invisibile; et ultima erat revolver niger mechanice intricatus.

source: Lumian didn’t rush to take out the rewards but instead unfolded the folded square letter.
target: Lumian non festinavit praemia extrahere, sed potius epistolam quadratam plicatam explicavit.

source: “Prize Descriptions: “Ironblood Knight potion formula: See for yourself.
target: “Praemiorum Descriptiones: Formula potionis ‘Eques Ferro‐sanguinei’: Vide tu ipse.

source: “Traveler’s Bag: No need for further introduction, right?
target: “Sacculus Viatoris: Non est opus ulterius explanare, nonne?

source: ‘Wintry Blade: A mystical item crafted from the dust of ancient vengeful spirits and residual spirituality.
target: ‘Gladius Hiemalis: Res arcana confecta ex pulvere veterum spirituum ultionis et residuae spiritualitatis.

source: Any creature pierced by it, even without a visible wound, will fall into an icy rigidity and uncontrollable thoughts, as if possessed by a Wraith.
target: Quaecumque creatura percursa eo, etiam sine vulnero conspicuo, in rigiditatem glaciei et cogitationes incontrollatas cadet, quasi umbra possessa.

source: Moreover, as the battle persists, the targets of the Wintry Blade, even without direct contact, will gradually find their thoughts slowing and movements becoming stiff and awkward.
target: Praeterea, dum pugna perseverat, victimis Gladii Hiemalis, etiam sine directo contactu, paulatim invenientur cogitationes retardari et motus rigidi atque inepti fieri.

source: The downside is that the bearer gradually loses body heat, turning toward a necrotic state.
target: Incommodum est quod portator paulatim calorem corporis amittit, se convertens in statum necroticum.

source: If this exceeds the necessary time limit, the process becomes irreversible.
target: Si hoc tempus necessario excedit, processus irreversibilis efficitur.

source: “Placing it in the Traveler’s Bag effectively avoids the negative effects of carrying it.
target: “In Sacculo Viatoris ponendo, effectus negativos vehendi efficaciter vitantur.

source: You only need to ensure the battle doesn’t exceed three hours.
target: Te solum necesse est providere ne pugna tres horas excedat.

source: Of course, as a Sequence 5 of the Hunter pathway, a burning Reaper, you could endure the negative effects for at least four hours without other countermeasures.”
target: Certe, ut Sequens V in via Venatoris, ardens Messor, effectus negativos saltem per quattuor horas absque aliis remediis tolerare possis.

source: Reading this, Lumian immediately thought of the Eggers family’s golden mask.
target: Hoc legens, Lumian statim larvam auream familiae Eggers meminisse sensit.

source: That mask could also turn the wearer into a dead being, providing protection for the spirit and consciousness to remain alive until the mask was removed, allowing the wearer to easily revert to their original state.
target: Illa larva etiam gerentem in entitatem mortuam convertere poterat, praebens tutela spiritui et conscientiae ut maneant in vita, donec larva sublata fuerit, permittens gerenti facile in statum suum initialem reverti.

source: While wearing Death’s golden mask, could I use the Wintry Blade completely unaffected?
target: Dum larvam auream Mortis gerens, num possum Gladium Hiemalem omnino sine perturbatione uti?

source: I’m already an undead, so the gradual necrosis doesn’t apply… No, wearing that golden mask for too long means real death once removed, resulting in instant death… Lumian found no exploitable loophole and sighed in disappointment.
target: Iam in statu mortuorum sum, igitur necrosis gradualis non valet… At vero, illam larvam auream nimis diu gerendo veram mortem, postquam sublata est, efficit mortem instantaneam… Lumian ullam viam expediendi invenit et dejectione suspiravit.

source: He continued reading the last part of the letter: “Winter is Coming: This revolver was found at the site of a secret but failed ritual while investigating the Order of All Extinction cult. It was meant to be a collectible firearm, but it became a formidable weapon with a limited number of uses due to corruption during the ritual.
target: Pergit ultimam partem epistolae legens: “Hiems Adventura: Hic revolver invenitus est in situ rituum secretorum sed fallitorum, cum cultum Ordinis Omnium Exstinctionis investigabant; destinatus erat esse arma collectaria, sed ob corruptionem in ritu limitato, factus est arma formidabilis.

source: “The bullets it fires carry that corruption, producing two effects: “One ensures the bullet hits its target; even Saints, unless they use special abilities to dodge, will be hit. For beings below demigods, unless they switch with a substitute or the shooter is under an illusion and unable to aim, the shot will hit its intended target, and any substitutes will fail.
target: “Globuli quos iacit hanc corruptionem portant, duo effectus efficiunt: Unum efficit ut globulus metam percutiat; etiam Sancti, nisi facultates speciales ad effugiendum utantur, percutientur. Pro entibus infra semideos, nisi substitutio fiat aut iaculans sub illusione intendere non valeat, ictus metam destinatum percutiet, et vicarii deficiunt.

source: “Two, ensures death; even Saints, lacking certain traits and abilities, once hit, will suffer great trauma and gradually die. For beings below demigods, a hit means certain death.
target: “Secundum efficit mortem; etiam Sancti, quibus quidam ingenia et facultates deficiunt, semel percussi magnum trauma patiuntur et paulatim moriantur. Pro entibus infra semideos, ictus mortem certam significat.

source: “These two effects cannot coexist; a choice is made for each shot.
target: Hi duo effectus simul esse non possunt; electio fit pro quolibet ictu.

source: “The number of times it can still carry these effects is four. Once used up, Winter is Coming will revert to a normal revolver and begin rusting and deteriorating. However, until then, its normal shots will also spread ailments with each wound, with the type of disease being unpredictable.
target: Numerus temporum quo adhuc hos effectus ferre potest, quattuor est. Postquam exhaustus erit, Hiems Adventura ad revolverum normale revertetur et rubigo corrumpi atque deteriorari incipiet. Tamen, usque ad hoc tempus, ictus eius normales etiam morbos disseminabunt, cuius generis morbus incertus erit.

source: “After each use of Winter is Coming, you must seek treatment from an Apothecary or Doctor within the following week, even if no symptoms appear.
target: Post singulos usus Hiems Adventura, medicinam quaerere debes ab Apothecario vel Medico intra hebdomadam sequentem, etiam si nullae signa apparent.

source: “If not treated in time, you will inevitably contract a terminal illness that lower-sequence Apothecaries and Doctors cannot cure due to mystical factors.”
target: Si non in tempore curatione succideris, inevitabiliter morbum terminalem contrahes, quod Apothecarii et Medici inferioris ordinis propter mysticos factores curare non possunt.

source: This is a weapon that can harm demigods…? After the Overseer Perle’s painted self incident, are Miss Magician and her peers consciously providing us with items that can affect demigods, with bearable side effects? Doctor… Lumian half-turned his body, casting his gaze toward the door.
target: Haec arma sunt quae semideos laedere possunt…? Post incidentem sui ipsius picti a Vigili Perle, num Domina Magica et socii eius conscie nobis praebent res quae semideos afficere possint cum effectibus tolerabilibus? Medice… Lumian dimidio corpore convertit et oculum ad ostium iecit.

source: Lugano had already woken up and was preparing Ludwig’s first breakfast.
target: Lugano iam excitatus erat et primum ientaculum Ludovici parabat.

source: After confirming the rewards, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and pulled out the brownish sheepskin parchment, written on in dark red ink:
target: Postquam praemia confirmavit, Lumian in Sacculo Viatoris profectus est et extraxit chartam membratam ex pelle ovina fusca, atramento rubro obscuro scripta:

source: “Potion name: Iron-blooded Knight; “Sequence: 4;
target: “Nomen potionis: Eques Ferro‐sanguinei; Sequentia: 4;

source: “Main ingredient: Magma Giant’s core, Stone of Catastrophe;
target: “Ingrediens principalis: Cor Magmae Gigantis, Lapis Catastrophae;

source: “Supplementary ingredients: 80 milliliters of boiling magma, 20 grams of flora powder corrupted by a Stone of Catastrophe, 20 grams of soil soaked in soldier’s blood from a large battlefield, one acorn;
target: “Ingrediens supplementarii: 80 millilitra magmae ferventis, 20 grammae pulveris floralis corrupti a Lapide Catastrophae, 20 grammae soli in sanguine militis infuso ex magno campo belli, unam glandem;

source: “Ritual: Form a team of at least 30 people, cultivate deep comradeship with them, allowing them to grow stronger together with perfect synergy, understanding the leader’s intent through eye contact and gestures, nearly as one entity, then have them perform the ritual (the stronger and more cohesive the team, the better the ritual’s effect).
target: “Ritual: Conforma coetum ex saltem triginta hominibus; colite arcanam foedus amicitiam cum illis, sinentes eos simul crescere fortiores in perfecta synergia, ducis propositum per oculos et gestus intueri, quasi unum entitatem; deinde eos fac ut ritualem peragant (quod coetus fortior et magis cohaerens, eo melius effectus ritus erit).

source: While reading, Lumian felt a strong burning sensation from the dark red inked words and thought he could smell rust and blood.
target: Dum legebat, Lumian vehementem ardorem ex verbis atramento rubro obscuro scriptis sensit et putavit se rubiginem et sanguinem odorare posse.

source: Phew… Lumian had just finished reading the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula and quickly set it down on the table, feeling as if he was sinking into a hell of flames and blood.
target: Phew… Lumian modo finem legendi formulae potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei attigit et celeriter eam in mensa deponit, sentiens quasi in infernum flammarum et sanguinis delabi.

source: Such a strong mental impact…
target: Tanta est vis impactus mentis…

source: Is it because the Sequence 4 potion formula inherently possesses such traits, or because it was written by an Angel, or perhaps a combination of both?
target: Num quia formula potionis Sequens IV insita haec possidet, aut quia ab Angelo redacta est, aut fortasse utrorumque mixtio?

source: Boiling magma… Does this mean drinking magma directly, and if you don’t advance, you die?
target: Magma fervens… Num hoc significat ut magma directe bibatur, et si non progredieris, morieris?

source: Lumian memorized the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula in his mind, occasionally opening the parchment to ensure there were no mistakes.
target: Lumian menti retinuit formulam potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei, interdum chartam aperiens ut nullae errores inessent.

source: In the morning, at 702 Apartment, 9 Rue Orosai.
target: Mane, in Appertamento 702, 9 via Orosai.

source: Lumian placed the new Traveler’s Bag and the two weapons on the coffee table and went into detail about the latter two.
target: Lumian novum Sacculum Viatoris et duas armas super mensa collocavit et de his duabus armis plenius narravit.

source: “Only three items?” Franca asked, puzzled.
target: “Nonne solum tres res sunt?” Franca quaesivit, perplexa.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridit.

source: “There’s also the Iron-blooded Knight Sequence 4 potion formula for the Hunter pathway, but that’s meaningless for you.”
target: Item etiam formula potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei Sequens IV pro via Venatoris existit, sed tibi nihil significat.

source: “Who says so? At Sequence 4, a Demoness can switch to the Hunter pathway!” Franca retorted, her eyes sparkling.
target: “Quis hoc dicit? Ad Sequens IV, Demonissa ad viam Venatoris transire potest!” Franca respondit, oculis fulgentibus.

source: She almost said that before joining the Demoness Sect, her dream was to obtain the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula to turn herself back into a male.
target: Haec paene dixit; antequam Sectam Demonissarum adiunxisset, somnium eius erat recipere formulam potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei ut se rursus in virum converteret.

source: Before Lumian could respond, Franca eagerly pleaded, “May I see it? It’s not like you’ll lose anything” This way, if I become a Demoness of Affliction and something forces me out of the Demoness Sect, I could consider advancing to Iron-blooded Knight!
target: Antequam Lumian responderet, Franca aviditer obsecravit: “Licetne mihi id videre? Non putas te aliquid amissurum esse?” Hoc modo, si Demonissa Afflictionis fiam et aliquid me ex Secta Demonissarum expellat, considerare possim in Eques Ferro‐sanguineo procedere!

source: “Sure.” Lumian replied nonchalantly.
target: “Certe.” Lumian respondit non sollicitus.

source: He knew what Franca truly desired.
target: Sciebat quid Franca vere desideraret.

source: He then took the brownish parchment out of his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Tum chartam fuscam e Sacculo Viatoris extraxit.

source: Seeing this, Jenna asked, curious yet hopeful, “May I have a look too?”
target: Hoc videns, Jenna quaesivit, curiosa sed spe plena: “Licetne mihi quoque videndi?”

source: This was a potion formula that could unlock the gates of godhood!
target: Haec erat formula potionis quae portas deitatis recludere posset!

source: “Uh…” Franca turned to Jenna, wanting to stop her but finding no suitable excuse.
target: “Eheu…” Franca ad Jennam conversa est, eam prohibere volens sed causam idoneam non inveniens.

source: Is it really appropriate for a female Demoness to look at the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula?
target: Num vere decet Demonissam feminam ut formulae potionis Eques Ferro‐sanguinei intueatur?

source: Lumian didn’t help Franca dissuade Jenna, and freely unfolded the brown parchment, placing it on the coffee table surface, and casually cautioned, “For every paragraph, take a look then close your eyes and rest for a few seconds—it has a strong mental impact.”
target: Lumian Francae non prodidit, ut Jennam dissuaderetur, sed chartam fuscam libere plicavit, eam super mensam posuit, et leviter monuit: “Pro quolibet paragraph, inspice deinde oculos claude atque pauca secunda quiesce; nam validum impulsum mentis habet.”

source: After a while, Franca, Jenna, and Anthony felt as though they had been roasted by a fire all night long, their sweat long since dried.
target: Post nonnullum tempus, Franca, Jenna, et Anthony sensit se quasi tota nocte igni torridi fuisse, sudor eorum iam olim exustus.

source: “It requires at least thirty people… That’s a bit difficult,” Franca said, empathizing with Lumian’s challenge.
target: “Saltem triginta homines requirit… id paulum difficile est,” Franca, Lumianis inceptis compatiens, dixit.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridit.

source: The stronger the team members, the better the effect. And if you have members with godhood in the team, the number required can be significantly reduced.
target: Quo fortiora membra coetus sunt, eo melius effectus erit. Et cum membra deitatis in coetu sint, numerus requisitus significanter minuitur.

source: Franca and Jenna thought of a name simultaneously and said in unison, “Ludwig?”
target: Franca et Jenna simul nomen excogitaverunt et in unisono dixerunt, “Ludwig?”

source: “I’m trying to teach him.” Lumian gave a godfatherly smile.
target: “Eum docere conor.” Lumian subridens quasi patruelis risum dedit.

source: Franca said no more and turned her attention to the three items: the Wintry Blade, Winter is Coming, and the Traveler’s Bag.
target: Franca nihil amplius addidit et animadvertit ad tres res: Gladius Hiemalis, Hiems Adventura, et Sacculus Viatoris.

source: She generously smiled and said, “Jenna, Anthony, you pick first. Just don’t leave the Traveler’s Bag for me—I already have one.”
target: Benigne subridens dixit: “Jenna, Anthony, vos primum eligite; tantummodo Sacculum Viatoris mihi non relinquam—iam unum habeo.”

source: She was worried about lacking a powerful or special effect item. Both the Wintry Blade and Winter is Coming perfectly met her needs—any would do. As an Assassin, her hidden blade was a normal weapon that could rely on Witch powers to attach black flames, while the Cannon Gun was akin to a portable mini-cannon, nothing special.
target: Timuit ne careat re potentia aut effectu speciali. Utrumque—Gladius Hiemalis et Hiems Adventura—prorsus opem eius fecerunt, et unumquodque sufficere posset. Ut sicatrix, culter eius occultus arma communia erant, quae virtutibus Maleficarum ad flammas nigras adligandas inniti poterant, dum Cannon Gun simile erat ad portabile parvum cannone, nihil speciale.

source: Anthony immediately looked at Jenna, signaling her to choose first.
target: Anthony statim in Jennam respexit, signum ei faciens ut primum eligat.

source: This was not out of courtesy—he wanted the Traveler’s Bag, and he wanted the other two items as well.
target: Hoc non ex urbanitate erat—ipse Sacculum Viatoris optabat, ac reliquas duas res quoque desiderabat.

source: Jenna looked at the Hypnotist, lacking direct attack capability, then at Franca, whose gaze moved back and forth between the Wintry Blade and Winter is Coming. She picked up the ark coin pouch and said with a smile, “I’ve always wanted a Traveler’s Bag.”
target: Jenna hypnosi aspiciens, directe oppugnandi facultate caret, deinde in Francam, cuius oculi inter Gladium Hiemalem et Hiems Adventuram vagabantur, intuefacta, saccum nummarium sustulit et subridens dixit: “Semper volui Sacculum Viatoris habere.”

source: This wasn’t a lie—many Witch spells required casting materials, and some items, even just by carrying them, could have negative effects, which could be barely avoided by placing them in the Traveler’s Bag, such as the Beyonder characteristic of the Dream Stealer.
target: Hoc non faba mendacium erat—multae incantationes Maleficarum materiis ad operandum exigerunt, et quaedam res, et solum eas portando, effectus negativos afferre poterant, qui vix evitari possent, ea in Sacculo Viatoris ponendo, sicut proprietas Beyonder Somniorum Furtoris.

source: Once Jenna took the Traveler’s Bag, Anthony quickly made his decision.
target: Postquam Jenna Sacculum Viatoris accepit, Anthony celeriter decrevit.

source: “I’ll take Winter is Coming.”
target: “Hiems Adventuram accipiam.”

source: Without a Traveler’s Bag, carrying the Wintry Blade would be a significant burden.
target: Sine Sacculo Viatoris, Gladium Hiemalem vehere gravissimum onus esset.

source: Franca looked at the nearly transparent triangular spike and smiled broadly.
target: Franca spiculum triangulare prope invisibilem aspexit et latissime subridit.

source: “I’ll see if I can have it made into a hidden blade.”
target: “Videbo an id in cultrum occultum fieri possit.”

source: These are all suitable rewards for us. Madam Judgment and company are so thoughtful…
target: Haec omnia praemia nobis apta sunt. Domina Iudicium et socii eius tam solliciti sunt…

source: Lumian watched his companions distribute the rewards, nodding thoughtfully.
target: Lumian comitum suorum praemia distribuere contemplatus est, capite cogitante annuens.

source: That evening, back in the rented apartment, he met Madam Magician again.
target: Illo vesperi, in apartamento conducto, iterum cum Domina Magica occurrit.

source: This Major Arcana card holder spoke bluntly, “Head to the Blue Avenger now.”
target: Hic tenens chartam Arcanae Maioris locutus est asperte: “Ad Caeruleum Vindex nunc propera.”
